title: watching U
description: This project adds a horror entity that watches you without you knowing its secretly there and ocacionally attacks.
body:
# What the mod adds?
This mods adds a single entity that stalks the player in the shadows,
It's recommended to have this mod with others due to the low chance
of the Watcher to spawn and increases chances for anomalys and making the world more immersive.

## Whats new?
In the recent update a new version beta of this mod had came out
1 new entity has been added and many bugs have been fixed the entities
have been remodeled and blend into the dark

### Compatability
This mod is only compatible on forge 1.20.1 and can be in a modpack/instance
with other mods too as long as they have the same version and
mod loade (version 1.20.1 loader forge)

### What to expect
This mod is a slowburning taking roughly 9 minutes on average
to spawn 1 entity there are very loud noises, flashing lights and
probably jumpscares depending on the situation

### Where do i report bugs?
**🐛Report bugs at https://discord.gg/karV3EH9av in the bug reports channel**

Most of all thank you for playing and have fun![The watcher](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90831fee20d2741e9aef9e6a202d1cac63f227e6_0.webp)
